title: How the U.S. operation to capture Maduro, his wife unfolded
summary: The operation to capture former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife involved more than 150 aircraft launched from 20 different military bases, Gen. Dan Caine said. A source familiar with the operation said a small team of CIA personnel had been on the ground in Venezuela since August, tracking Maduro's movements. Charlie D'Agata reports more on…
